round3: All three round-3 blocking findings and all eight minors are fixed. I answered each round-3 thread.

keyFindings.description: envoy-go-race is red at 5593037ddf83. Every handover pass resolves the role's holder before it reads the kept lane, so every POST /v1/roles/set starts a goroutine that does a claim read and a session read even for a role nothing was ever kept for. TestARoleHolderWhoseSessionCannotBeReadKeepsItsClaim swaps the session registry after its claim, and the race detector fails it. Fix: open each pass with the lane-head read that keptRoleCopiesLeft does (one helper shared with walkKeptRole's opening), and resolve the holder only when copies are left. A claim of a role with no kept lane then costs one stream read again.

Envelope.Keep has no producer now that the outbox reversal is done. Only api.go:754 writes it, copying the request flag onto the envelope, and the envelope then carries keep:false onto every forward to a holder (confirmed.go:399) and every publish answer, which means every daemon notice and phase reminder. The contract (envelope.ts, envelope.schema.json, generated.go) and two fragments advertise a raw-lane opt-out that nothing uses. Delete the field and check the request's flag in the route's give-up (one flag, on the request).
keptRoleCopiesLeft repeats walkKeptRole's opening reads, error texts and comparison. Use one helper (also the fix for the red lane).
The decision after each walk is split between roleKeepDrainAgain and the loop's re-branch on result.end, with the progress test written twice. Write it as one switch.

The sweep logs 'found a lane no handover was draining' at Info and starts a goroutine before it knows the role has a live holder. A role with no holder keeps its lane ahead of the cursor for 72 h, so every listener logs and works on it every 5 minutes. Check the holder first, or log only when a walk runs.
